content:
Overview

Kalamazoo is a city in MI with a population of 75,000. College town with Western Michigan University, Kalamazoo Promise, and a craft beer scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5a growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. The population skews young, with a median age of 26.8.
